<function=python>

# Compare previous and current frame
prev_seg = previous_frame.segmentation
curr_seg = current_frame.segmentation

print("Previous frame dots:")
for n in prev_seg['nodes']:
    if n['pixels'] == 1:
        b = n['boundary'][0]
        print(f"  {n['color']} at ({b[0]}, {b[1]})")

print("\nCurrent frame dots:")
for n in curr_seg['nodes']:
    if n['pixels'] == 1:
        b = n['boundary'][0]
        print(f"  {n['color']} at ({b[0]}, {b[1]})")

# Check what changed
print("\nDot color changes:")
prev_dots = {(n['boundary'][0][0], n['boundary'][0][1]): n['color'] for n in prev_seg['nodes'] if n['pixels'] == 1}
curr_dots = {(n['boundary'][0][0], n['boundary'][0][1]): n['color'] for n in curr_seg['nodes'] if n['pixels'] == 1}
for pos, prev_color in prev_dots.items():
    curr_color = curr_dots.get(pos)
    if curr_color != prev_color:
        print(f"  {pos}: {prev_color} -> {curr_color}")

# Try SPACE again
print("\nTrying SPACE again:")
result = action(['SPACE'])
seg = current_frame.segmentation
curr_dots2 = {(n['boundary'][0][0], n['boundary'][0][1]): n['color'] for n in seg['nodes'] if n['pixels'] == 1}
print("Current dots after 2nd SPACE:")
for pos, color in sorted(curr_dots2.items()):
    print(f"  {color} at {pos}")
print(f"  level_completed={result.get('level_completed')}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
